purpose: Exercise tactical-state and annotation logic against candidate-independent synthetic ground truth before any reality calibration.
observation_model: T0 is fully observable: actor identity, line role, timing, and continuity are intentionally unambiguous unless the case explicitly tests UNKNOWN.

cases.mechanism: line leader attacks occupied forward position; direct follower stays attached
line leader attacks; direct follower gaps and does not recover within 6s
line leader attacks into open forward space; follower remains attached
solo leader takes open forward space without contest
follower gaps briefly then re-establishes direct attachment inside 6s during contested move
follower reattaches only after 6s cutoff
solo rider attacks occupied forward position
line leader advances materially into unoccupied forward position
brief wheel overlap without sustained forward attack
final sprint overtake only
apparent move but actor continuity intentionally unresolvable
attack described but no observable sustained movement
leader feints and returns without material forward challenge
attack visible and contested; follower visibility intentionally insufficient
follower visible; occupied-position contest visibility intentionally insufficient
attack qualification visible but both six-second downstream windows partly occluded
incumbent actively blocks while attacker sustains longitudinal overlap
line fragments during attack; direct follower switches path and reattaches inside 6s
intervening rider enters between attacker and expected follower; no direct recovery
race contains positioning changes but no qualifying initiative attack
two temporally distinct independent attacks in one race
one sustained attack contains a second acceleration that must not become another anchor
three-rider line leader attacks, second rider follows, third rider drops; BANTE concerns direct expected follower only
three-rider line: direct follower drops but third rider advances; third rider must not substitute for direct follower

required_checks: Pass A attack discovery is evaluated without downstream labels changing anchors.
Pass B uses only frozen synthetic Pass A anchors.
UNKNOWN remains distinct from ABSENT and PRESENT.
Six-second boundary behavior is tested explicitly.
Zero-anchor and multi-anchor races are represented.
Direct-follower semantics are tested separately from any-line-following behavior.
next_gate: Run protocol-conformance scoring on this T0 set, then add T1 observation ambiguity. Do not infer reality prevalence from T0 case frequencies.
